evidence.title: InclusiveColors: WCAG accessible color palette creator for Tailwind/CSS/Figma/Adobe
InclusiveColors: WCAG accessible color palette creator for Tailwind/CSS/Figma/Adobe

name: InclusiveColors
summary: Palette creator for accessible color systems, with WCAG and APCA contrast checking and code export.
description: A beta web tool for building branded color palettes that meet WCAG, ADA and Section 508 contrast requirements. It uses an HSLuv picker for perceptually uniform lightness, shows which color pairs contrast as you edit, and exports palettes as Tailwind config, CSS variables, DTCG design tokens, .ase, .svg or .png.
contains: palette editor with HSLuv color picker
WCAG 2 and APCA contrast checking per color pair
option to link lightness curves between swatches
export as Tailwind config.js, CSS variables, DTCG tokens, .ase, .svg or .png
no autogenerated colors or AI features
